controls.name: Change authorization
controls.objective: Production changes are authorized by an appropriate approver. Standard changes are approved before deployment; emergency changes are approved retrospectively within 2 business days.
attributes: emergency: approved within 2 business days after deployment

controls.name: Segregation of duties
controls.objective: The developer of a change does not approve it or deploy it to production.

controls.name: Testing and user acceptance
controls.objective: Changes are tested and user acceptance evidence is retained before deployment.

controls.name: Emergency change post-implementation review
controls.objective: Emergency changes receive a post-implementation review (PIR) within 2 business days of deployment.

controls.name: Completeness of change population
controls.objective: Every production deployment traces to a valid, approved change ticket (detects unauthorized changes).
attributes: ticket reference exists in change system
